rows.label: qst500110_msg0002
rows.name:
When Neanea came here before, there
wasn't a cave-in like this, mo!

rows.label: qst500110_msg0003
rows.name:
I think it collapsed because the
ground was shaking so much, mo.

rows.label: qst500110_msg0004
rows.name:
So Neanea is taking the chance to look
for Linka Honey here, mo!

rows.label: qst500110_msg0005
rows.name:
Putting it in juice should make
a drink so delicious it could make
you faint, mo!

rows.label: qst500110_msg0006
rows.name: But I still can't find any, mo...

rows.label: qst500110_msg0007
rows.name:
If you find any, please tell me, mo.
The scent is drifting from somewhere,
so it must be in Morytha's Cliffs, mo!

rows.label: qst500110_msg0009
rows.name: Do you have Linka Honey, mo?

rows.label: qst500110_msg0010
rows.name: Where in the world did you get it, mo?

rows.label: qst500110_msg0011
rows.name:
That makes sense, mo! Neanea was
looking somewhere else entirely, mo.

rows.label: qst500110_msg0012
rows.name: I'll go get some right away, mooo!

rows.label: qst500110_msg0013
rows.name:
Oh, right. My other siblings are also
looking for juice ingredients, mo.

rows.label: qst500110_msg0014
rows.name:
If you meet them, please be as kind
to them as you were to me, mo!
